content: ⌊ DRAFT g The bit SWCLUC_BMANIF_DISABLE_ON_ECU_ CONNECTION in the element ConnectorControlFlags of the Binary Mani- fest Header shall be set if the SwCluCBManifOnBoardConnectorControl is set to DISABLE_ON_ECU_CONNECTOR . Otherwise, the bit is not set (value 0).
